name: siteos
description: One SiteOS plugin for CLI, Auth, Pulse, Forms, Search, and Search analytics workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Operate SiteOS services through one plugin and one CLI
interface.longDescription: SiteOS routes setup and cross-service work to focused skills for the unified CLI, central Auth, and product-owned Pulse, Forms, and Search Projects without coupling their data or lifecycles.
defaultPrompt: $siteos set up SiteOS for this repository and route the work to the required services
$siteos-cli inspect CLI readiness and available commands
$siteos-auth authenticate and select the correct Organization
$siteos-search inspect this external project and configure managed search
$siteos-forms add a managed contact form to this project
$siteos-analytics inspect search health and usage for this linked project
